review: 602.5c-1: the first variant carried a delta, so the scenario had no base; made 'second_source' the base with an empty delta (activating U2 is now the final decision) and rewrote 'first_source_again' as the one-fact change to U1.

602.5e-1: 'during_payment' claimed can_play false for Giant Growth, which the rules do not decide (A could activate the Pendant at priority first); the expected now states only that the Pendant activation during payment is illegal and the cast is reversed with nothing milled.

scenarios.title: A payment modification applies to the total activation cost after an increase

setup.notes: All six Grizzly Bears are untapped and have been under A's control since before this turn. Neither player has lands. Heirloom Epic: {4}, {T}: draw a card; for each mana in its activation cost A may tap an untapped creature rather than pay that mana. Suppression Field raises the cost of non-mana activated abilities by {2}.

decisions: A, holding priority in main1 with an empty stack, activates Heirloom Epic.
The total activation cost is {4} plus {2} from Suppression Field, six mana; A pays each of the six by tapping a different untapped Grizzly Bears, and taps Heirloom Epic for the {T} part.
Both players pass; the ability resolves.

variants.label: six_creatures
variants.expected: Activating Heirloom Epic is legal (can_play true) at an adjusted cost of {6}; all six Grizzly Bears and Heirloom Epic become tapped and A draws 1 card (the Island) when the ability resolves.

variants.label: five_creatures
variants.delta: A controls five Grizzly Bears instead of six.
variants.expected: Activating Heirloom Epic is not legal (can_play false): the adjusted cost is still {6} and only five of its mana can be replaced by tapping creatures; nothing is tapped and A draws no card.

variants.label: no_field
variants.delta: Suppression Field is not on the battlefield (A still controls six Grizzly Bears).
variants.expected: Activating Heirloom Epic is legal at an adjusted cost of {4}; A taps four Grizzly Bears (the other two stay untapped) and Heirloom Epic, and draws 1 card.

scenarios.forge_notes: Heirloom Epic uses TapCreaturesForMana$ True; check that Forge counts the Suppression Field increase before offering creature taps.

scenarios.title: Only the controller can activate an activated ability

setup.notes: A cast Lightning Bolt targeting B earlier in main1; it is on the stack and A has just received priority. Prodigal Pyromancer has been under A's control since before this turn.

decisions: A, holding priority, activates Prodigal Pyromancer ({T}), targeting B.
Both players pass; the ability resolves, then Lightning Bolt resolves.

variants.label: controller_activates
variants.expected: A's activation of Prodigal Pyromancer is legal (can_play true for A); the ability goes on the stack above Lightning Bolt and resolves first, dealing 1 damage to B, and Lightning Bolt then deals 3 so B ends at 16.

variants.label: opponent_activates
variants.delta: A passes priority instead; B, now holding priority with Lightning Bolt on the stack, tries to activate A's Prodigal Pyromancer targeting A.
variants.expected: B's activation is not legal (can_play false for B): Prodigal Pyromancer stays untapped, no ability is put on the stack, and A's life is unchanged.

scenarios.forge_notes: The Lightning Bolt on the stack can be reached by A casting it from hand with a Mountain.

scenarios.title: An activated ability on the stack is an object independent of its source

setup.notes: Prodigal Pyromancer has been under A's control since before this turn.

decisions: A activates Prodigal Pyromancer ({T}), targeting B; the ability goes on the stack.
A passes priority; B passes priority (base variant); the ability resolves.

variants.label: resolves
variants.expected: The ability resolves and deals 1 damage to B (B at 19); Prodigal Pyromancer stays tapped on the battlefield.

variants.label: countered
variants.delta: In response B casts Stifle (tapping Island) targeting the ability; both players pass and Stifle resolves.
variants.expected: The ability is countered and does nothing: B stays at 20, Prodigal Pyromancer stays on the battlefield tapped, and Stifle is in B's graveyard.

variants.label: source_dies
variants.delta: In response B casts Shock (tapping Mountain) targeting Prodigal Pyromancer; both players pass and Shock resolves first.
variants.expected: Shock resolves first and Prodigal Pyromancer moves to A's graveyard, yet the ability still on the stack then resolves and deals 1 damage to B (B at 19).

scenarios.title: A cost-altering activated ability does not change a spell already on the stack

setup.notes: Kaza, Roil Chaser has haste. A controls one Wizard (Kaza), so its ability reduces the next instant or sorcery by {1}.

decisions: A casts Divination ({2}{U}) tapping three Islands; it goes on the stack.
A, holding priority, activates Kaza ({T}); the ability resolves and creates the cost reduction for the next instant or sorcery A casts this turn.
Both players pass; Divination resolves.

variants.label: activated_after_cast
variants.expected: Divination was cast for the full {2}{U}: three Islands tapped and the fourth untapped, no mana refunded, and Divination resolves normally, A draws 2 cards.

variants.label: activated_before_cast
variants.delta: A activates Kaza first and lets the ability resolve, then casts Divination.
variants.expected: Divination costs {1}{U}: only two Islands are tapped and two stay untapped; Divination resolves and A draws 2 cards.

scenarios.title: An ability that is prohibited from being activated cannot be activated

setup.notes: Pithing Needle is controlled by B; as it entered, B chose the name 'Prodigal Pyromancer'. Prodigal Pyromancer has been under A's control since before this turn.

decisions: A, holding priority in main1 with an empty stack, tries to activate Prodigal Pyromancer ({T}) targeting B.

variants.label: named
variants.expected: A's activation is not legal (can_play false): Prodigal Pyromancer is not tapped, nothing goes on the stack, and B's life stays 20.

variants.label: other_name
variants.delta: Pithing Needle's chosen name is 'Grizzly Bears' instead.
variants.expected: A's activation is legal (can_play true): Prodigal Pyromancer taps and its ability resolves, dealing 1 damage to B (B at 19).

scenarios.forge_notes: The name choice on Pithing Needle is set directly in the puzzle state.

scenarios.title: A summoning-sick creature cannot use an ability with {T} in its cost

setup.notes: Prodigal Pyromancer came under A's control this turn and has no haste.

decisions: A, holding priority in main1 with an empty stack, tries to activate the creature's ability, targeting B.

variants.label: sick_tap_ability
variants.expected: The activation of Prodigal Pyromancer's {T} ability is not legal (can_play false): it stays untapped and B's life stays 20.

variants.label: not_sick
variants.delta: Prodigal Pyromancer has been under A's control since the start of A's turn (not summoning sick).
variants.expected: The activation is legal; Prodigal Pyromancer taps and its ability resolves, dealing 1 damage to B (B at 19).

variants.label: haste
variants.delta: The summoning-sick creature is Vulshok Sorcerer (haste, {T}: 1 damage to any target) instead of Prodigal Pyromancer.
variants.expected: The activation is legal despite the creature having come under A's control this turn; Vulshok Sorcerer taps and deals 1 damage to B (B at 19).

variants.label: no_tap_cost
variants.delta: The summoning-sick creature is Basking Rootwalla and A activates its {1}{G} ability, tapping both Forests.
variants.expected: The activation is legal because the cost has no {T}; Basking Rootwalla gets +2/+2 until end of turn and is 3/3.

scenarios.title: A use restriction continues to apply after the object changes controller

setup.notes: Basking Rootwalla: {1}{G}: +2/+2 until end of turn. Activate only once each turn.

decisions: B casts Act of Treason targeting Basking Rootwalla, tapping three Mountains.
A receives priority and, in response, activates Basking Rootwalla ({1}{G}, tapping both Forests); both players pass and the ability resolves, making it 3/3 until end of turn.
Both players pass again; Act of Treason resolves: B gains control of Basking Rootwalla until end of turn, untaps it, and it gains haste.
B, holding priority, tries to activate Basking Rootwalla paying {1}{G} with B's two Forests.

variants.label: already_activated
variants.expected: B's activation is not legal (can_play false): the once-each-turn limit was already used while A controlled it; no ability goes on the stack and B's Forests stay untapped. Basking Rootwalla is 3/3 under B's control.

variants.label: not_yet_activated
variants.delta: A does not respond to Act of Treason, so Basking Rootwalla has not been activated this turn.
variants.expected: B's activation is legal; B taps both Forests, the ability resolves and Basking Rootwalla is 3/3 until end of turn under B's control.

scenarios.forge_notes: In the not_yet_activated variant A holds its two Forests unspent.

scenarios.title: A restriction on an acquired ability applies only to the ability acquired from that object

setup.notes: Prodigal Pyromancer has been under A's control since before this turn. Touch of Vitae: until end of turn, target creature gains haste and '{0}: Untap this creature. Activate only once.'

decisions: A activates Prodigal Pyromancer ({T}) targeting B; it resolves (B at 19) and the Pyromancer is tapped.
A casts the first Touch of Vitae targeting Prodigal Pyromancer (three Forests); it resolves, granting untap ability U1.
A casts the second Touch of Vitae targeting Prodigal Pyromancer (three Forests); it resolves, granting untap ability U2.
A activates U1 ({0}); it resolves and the Pyromancer untaps.
A activates Prodigal Pyromancer ({T}) targeting B; it resolves (B at 18) and the Pyromancer is tapped.
A activates U2, the untap ability granted by the second Touch of Vitae ({0}).

variants.label: second_source
variants.expected: The activation is legal (can_play true): U2 has not been used, so it goes on the stack, resolves, and Prodigal Pyromancer untaps.

variants.label: first_source_again
variants.delta: A activates U1, the untap ability granted by the first Touch of Vitae, a second time instead of U2.
variants.expected: The activation is not legal (can_play false): U1 is limited to one activation; nothing goes on the stack and Prodigal Pyromancer stays tapped.

scenarios.forge_notes: Each Touch of Vitae animates its own copy of the ABUntap ability; confirm Forge keeps a separate GameActivationLimit count for each copy.

scenarios.title: An 'activate only as a sorcery' ability needs sorcery timing

setup.notes: Grizzly Bears has been under A's control since before this turn. Equip abilities can be activated only at sorcery timing.

decisions: A, holding priority, activates Bonesplitter's equip {1} targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping a Mountain.
Both players pass; the ability resolves.

variants.label: main_empty_stack
variants.expected: The equip activation is legal (can_play true); it resolves and Bonesplitter is attached to Grizzly Bears, which is 4/2.

variants.label: stack_not_empty
variants.delta: Before equipping, A casts Lightning Bolt targeting B (tapping a Mountain) and, still holding priority with it on the stack, tries to activate equip.
variants.expected: The equip activation is not legal (can_play false): Bonesplitter stays unattached while Lightning Bolt is on the stack.

variants.label: combat
variants.delta: The step is beginning_of_combat instead of main1 and the stack is empty.
variants.expected: The equip activation is not legal (can_play false): Bonesplitter stays unattached and Grizzly Bears is 2/2.

scenarios.title: An 'activate only as an instant' ability can be activated at priority but not while paying a cost

setup.notes: A controls no lands. Charmed Pendant: {T}, mill a card: for each colored mana symbol in the milled card's mana cost add one mana of that color. Activate only as an instant.

decisions: B passes priority in B's upkeep with an empty stack.
A, holding priority, activates Charmed Pendant: taps it and mills the top card of A's library (Grizzly Bears, {1}{G}), adding {G}.

variants.label: priority_empty_stack
variants.expected: The activation is legal (can_play true): Charmed Pendant taps, Grizzly Bears moves from A's library to A's graveyard and A adds {G}.

variants.label: priority_stack_not_empty
variants.delta: B first casts Lightning Bolt targeting A's Grizzly Bears (tapping Mountain), and A activates Charmed Pendant with the Bolt on the stack.
variants.expected: The activation is still legal (can_play true): Charmed Pendant taps, the top Grizzly Bears is milled and A adds {G}; Lightning Bolt remains on the stack.

variants.label: during_payment
variants.delta: A instead casts Giant Growth targeting its Grizzly Bears and tries to pay the {G} by activating Charmed Pendant while paying the cost.
variants.expected: A's activation of Charmed Pendant while paying Giant Growth's cost is not legal: no mana is added, the Giant Growth cast cannot be completed and is reversed, Giant Growth stays in A's hand, Charmed Pendant stays untapped and nothing is milled.

scenarios.forge_notes: SpellAbilityRestriction rejects an InstantSpeed mana ability while a cost payment is in progress.
